rachel: heads-up — encountered a weird parity issue while running the onboarding quickstart: the REST API accepts duplicate query params for arrays (e.g., ?stop=\n&stop=###) but the Python SDK URL-encodes arrays as stop=%5B%22\n\n%22%2C%22###%22%5D which the server currently treats as a single string. First-time users see their stop sequences ignored.

diego: ouch. can you paste the repro?

rachel: sure. REST curl (works):
```
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/generate?stop=\n\n&stop=###" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# -> respects both stops
```
Python SDK (broken):
```
client.generate(stop=["\n\n","###"])
# -> server treats stop as the literal string '["\n\n","###"]'
```
mei: that's a parameter-encoding mismatch. The server supports repeated query params for arrays. SDK should either repeat them or send JSON body for arrays per API contract. Which SDK did you use (requests / httpx wrapper)?

rachel: httpx-based client. Also noticed header normalization: our SDK lowercases custom headers before sending which breaks some signed webhook tests where the server expects header case preserved for HMAC canonicalization. We silently lose the signature check in staging.

diego: two related problems then: (1) query-array encoding, (2) header-casing normalization affecting HMAC. Both are subtle and break onboarding/sampleapp integrations.

mei: actionable items: (A) change client URL building to support repeat-query behavior when param is list and the endpoint expects array-in-query; (B) add an opt-in `preserve_header_case` flag and a warning for signing use-cases; (C) add integration tests in quickstart that exercise array-in-query + webhook signing.

rachel: also found another small drift: REST tolerates trailing commas in JSON payloads (we're lenient server-side), but SDK JSON serializer refuses to send payloads with trailing commas that some legacy sampleapps still produce. It causes mismatched behavior when developers copy-paste examples that happen to include a trailing comma.

diego: ideally the server shouldn't accept invalid JSON but rollback is a bigger product decision. For now, SDK should not be stricter than server on innocuous cases that break onboarding. Maybe provide a `lenient_serialization` compatibility flag?

mei: I'll open DX-449. Plan details: 1) patch httpx wrapper to emit repeated query params for lists; 2) add tests for query-array shapes (repeat vs csv vs json-body); 3) add header-case preserve option and document HMAC implications; 4) add a quickstart CI job hitting staging that runs form-posts + webhook roundtrip.

ci-bot: jira:DX-449 created by mei — "SDK parity: repeat-query arrays + header-case preservation + lenient serialization for onboarding" :memo:

rachel: thanks, will link sampleapp PR in the ticket and re-run onboarding after patches. Also adding a short note in the quickstart README about typical form shapes (empty string, null, repeated-query arrays). :seedling:

diego: good call. tagging eng-sdks + eng-runtime. Mei, assigning to you for the SDK patch.

mei: on it. I'll include a migration snippet for maintainers: example of how to opt in to header-case preservation and to toggle array encoding to legacy mode.
